description: This file defines the Vtiger_InvoicePDFController class, which extends InventoryPDFController to generate PDF representations of invoices within the vtiger CRM system. The class contains methods for building header models for the PDF, including titles, column data, addresses, and watermark content based on invoice data.

classes.name: Vtiger_InvoicePDFController
classes.description: Controller class for generating invoice PDF documents, extending inventory PDF functions to include invoice-specific details.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelTitle
methods.description: Builds the title for the invoice PDF header, including invoice number and module label.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnCenter
methods.description: Constructs the central column of the header with customer, contact, purchase, and sales order details.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnRight
methods.description: Constructs the right column of the header with issue and due dates, billing, and shipping addresses.

methods.name: getWatermarkContent
methods.description: Provides content for watermarking the PDF, based on invoice status.
